---
title: "Clustering & Marker Genes"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("R/read_manifest.R")
source("R/read_summary.R")
source("R/plot_helpers.R")
source("R/load_seurat.R")

result_dir <- "data"
manifest <- read_manifest(result_dir)

cluster_step <- find_step(manifest, "cluster_markers")
cluster_summary <- if (!is.null(cluster_step)) read_step_summary(result_dir, cluster_step$summary) else NULL
```

## Cluster Marker Summary

```{r cluster-status}
if (is.null(cluster_summary)) {
  cat("Cluster marker summary not available.")
} else {
  cat(paste0("Status: **", cluster_summary$status, "**  "))
  cat(paste0("Timestamp: ", cluster_summary$timestamp))
}
```

## Multi-Resolution UMAP

```{r cluster-plots, fig.cap="UMAP across multiple clustering resolutions", out.width="100%"}
if (!is.null(cluster_summary)) {
  img_path <- find_artifact(cluster_summary, "png")
  if (!is.null(img_path)) {
    display_image(result_dir, img_path)
  } else {
    cat("No clustering plot found.")
  }
}
```

## Top Marker Genes

```{r marker-table}
marker_csv <- file.path(result_dir, "cluster/marker_gene", paste0(manifest$integration_method, "_clusters_marker_list.csv"))
if (file.exists(marker_csv)) {
  markers <- read.csv(marker_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  knitr::kable(head(markers, 50), format = "html")
} else {
  cat("Marker gene list not found.")
}
```
